evidence: This is a terrain tile patch of sci-fi floor panels, which is a horizontal ground surface seen from above (rows 0-47) with inset bevels and bolts.

style.evidence: While the metal ramp has 5 blue-grey steps plus 3 cyan steps for the light, several areas on the panels (e.g. rows 4-8 in tile 1, rows 3-7 in tile 3) have flat single-color fills of 5x5+ pixels, and the 3 rows are identical duplicates.
